reuse.why: All six link handlers go through one linkBankSyncAccount built on link.findOrCreateBank; Akahu's download is generalised into downloadServerTransactions for Fintegra, and the unlink field reset is shared with unlinkAccount through unlinkedAccountFields.

duplication.why: The copied link blocks and the Akahu download are consolidated rather than copied; only fintegraAccounts repeats the per-provider account-listing pattern.

placement.why: Linking rules sit in accounts/app.ts with the handlers and unlinkAccount, the generic download in sync.ts, the URL in server-config.ts and the type in types/models.

scope.why: Adds a fintegra-accounts listing handler and SYNC_PROVIDERS/desktop-client entries that the server-only requests did not ask for.

maintainability.why: One linking path holds the closed, duplicate and take-over rules with explicit per-provider parameters; the shared helper now passes cloudFileId for every provider, which quietly flattens what used to be Pluggy-only.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every *-accounts-link handler delegates to linkBankSyncAccount; unlinkAccount and the take-over both use unlinkedAccountFields.

disguised_duplication.where: fintegraAccounts is an open copy of the provider account-listing pattern; nothing is renamed to hide a copy.

abstraction_drift.where: Across steps 1-4 linkBankSyncAccount gained only replaceExistingLink; the closed-account and already-linked checks are general rules for all providers, syncEventTables preserves the step-0 Akahu variation, and no handler bypasses the helper.
